description: Current price of up to 25 cryptocurrencies by CoinGecko id (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, usd-coin…) in up to 5 currencies, with 24-hour change and market cap. Use to price coins that are not on-chain tokens, value a portfolio in several currencies, or check a move. Example: ids=bitcoin,ethereum. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
